property_summary: For every call to C.transfer, the recorded calldata of each external call made to the counterparty must be abi.encodeWithSelector(keccak256('transferFrom(address,address,uint256)'), from, to, v), so the selector must be the canonical transferFrom selector; the buggy version appends a space so the recorded selector is different.
change_summary: Change the function selector string from transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transferFrom(address,address,uint256)  with an extra space, making the external call selector different.
